overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Small-Mid Cap ETF (TMSL) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on extended market equity. TMSL is an actively managed fund that invests in US small- and mid-cap companies with either growth or value characteristics TMSL was launched on Jun 14, 2023 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
